Name: yassified willy portraits
Author: deleted56164987
Description:
[size=4]disclaimer! my mods still work, however, in order to use the seasonal version, you must use the legacy version instead of
the most recent one.[/size]

per popular request (2 people) here's a re-work of willy's portraits that keep him an old man but [i]yassified.[/i]

-----------------------------

this mod has two versions, vanilla and seasonal. plus compatible portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking For Love Redux[/url]

- vanilla will only replace his main and winter outfit. after downloading, drop it inside your mods folder.

- seasonal replaces all of his outfits with brand new ones. you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] in order for it to work. after downloading it, drop the 'assets' folder inside
[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and let it override.

- for Looking for Love, drop the assets folder inside [CP] Looking for Love.

 -----------------------------

thank you so much for the endorsements and kind comments! i really appreciate it :] also, please let me know if you find any visual bugs.
